## Purpose
Shared constants for the app: theme lists, default custom theme values, error descriptors and a few UI/storage constants. They are imported by [[src-utils]] and by several components.

## Key concepts
- `DEFAULT_THEMES` is the list of daisyUI theme names (includes custom `procyon`); first entry is the initial state in [[src-components]].
- `DEFAULT_CUSTOM_THEME` supplies fallbacks for the custom theme CSS variables.
- `CustomError` plus `INVALID_CONFIG_ERROR`, `INVALID_GITHUB_USERNAME_ERROR`, `GENERIC_ERROR` and `setTooManyRequestError(resetTime)` feed the error page.
- `LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY_NAME` (`gitprofile-theme`), `BG_COLOR` (`bg-base-300`) and `FALLBACK_IMAGE` (inline base64 PNG) are in `index.tsx`.

## Gotchas
- `errors.tsx` contains JSX, so it must stay a `.tsx` file.
- `FALLBACK_IMAGE` is a large inline data URI; avoid printing or diffing it.
